title: Sophos Mobile (unofficial)
auth: OAuth client credentials: a Sophos Fusion API credential, a token from id.sophos.com with the scope token, and the tenant ID and Sophos Mobile API host as connection settings
author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: Lock and send message only: no wipe, locate or unenroll. Not tested in a tenant with Sophos Mobile yet. On 2026-10-16 a renamed copy imported into a Sophos Fusion tenant without Sophos Mobile, exported again unchanged apart from the order of its functions, and was deleted.
